meta.purpose: Every Conversation level > unit > day > activity, with the real page id and route, so teacher mode can build one flat start-from-here list without guessing.
rules: One row = one activity a teacher can start on its own.
Day 3 is nine separate activities because each has its own route (a=<step>).
Day 2, Day 4, Day 5 and Day 6 are one activity each; their internal steps/sections stay inside the activity.
Midterm 1, Midterm 2 and Final have no six-day cycle: Review climb + big test only.
Review books (Basic Review, Int 3 Review, Int 2 Review) have 6 songs + Review Quiz + Review Unit Test + AI Chat per unit.
status=coming_soon means there is no page yet; do not link it, show it greyed.
teacher mode must open the activity at the start of that activity, never at the start of the unit.
